title: Enhancing Challenging Target Screening via Multimodal Protein-Ligand Contrastive Learning
authors: Wang Z; Wang Z; Yang M; Pang L; Nie F; Liu S; Gao Z; Zhao G; Ji X; Huang D; Zhu Z; Li D; Yuan Y; Zheng H; Zhang L; Ke G; Wang D; Yu F
one_liner_zh: 该文提出多模态蛋白-配体对比学习框架Uni-Clip，用于难成药靶点筛选，并在靶点钓鱼中发现无序蛋白c-Myc为潜在靶点，虽涉及IDP但核心是配体筛选而非IDP介导的PPI机制建模，方法可迁移但互作机制深度有限。
abstract: Recent advancements in genomics and proteomics have identified numerous clinically significant protein targets, with notably 85% categorized as undruggable. These targets present widespread challenges due to their complex structures and dynamics, rendering conventional drug design strategies not always effective. In this study, we introduce Uni-Clip, a contrastive learning framework that incorporates multi-modal features of proteins (structure and residue) and ligands (conformation and graph). Optimized with a specifically designed CF-InfoNCE loss, Uni-Clip enhances the modeling of protein-ligand interactions for both undruggable and druggable proteins. Uni-Clip demonstrates superior performance in benchmark evaluations on widely acknowledged datasets, LIT-PCBA and DUD-E, achieving a 147% and 218% improvements in enrichment factors at 1% compared to baselines. Furthermore, Uni-Clip proves to be a practical tool for various drug discovery applications. In virtual screening for the challenging protein target GPX4 with flat surface, it identified non-covalent inhibitors with an IC 50 of 4.17 μM, in contrast to the predominantly covalent inhibitors currently known. Through target fishing for benzbromarone, Uni-Clip identified the intrinsically disordered protein c-Myc as a potential target, highlighting benzbromarone’s potential for repurposing in cancer therapy. Explainable analyses effectively identified binding sites consistent with molecular dynamics and experimental results, even for challenging undruggable targets.
abstract_zh: 基因组学和蛋白质组学的最新进展已识别出众多具有临床意义的蛋白质靶点，其中显著有85%被归类为不可成药靶点。这些靶点因其复杂的结构和动态特性而带来广泛挑战，使得常规药物设计策略并非总是有效。在本研究中，我们引入了Uni-Clip，一种对比学习框架，整合了蛋白质（结构和残基）和配体（构象和图）的多模态特征。通过专门设计的CF-InfoNCE损失进行优化，Uni-Clip增强了对不可成药和可成药蛋白质的蛋白质-配体相互作用的建模。在广泛认可的LIT-PCBA和DUD-E数据集上的基准评估中，Uni-Clip表现出卓越性能，在1%富集因子方面相较于基线实现了147%和218%的提升。此外，Uni-Clip被证明是多种药物发现应用中的实用工具。在对具有平坦表面的挑战性蛋白质靶点GPX4的虚拟筛选中，它识别出IC 50为4.17 μM的非共价抑制剂，与目前已知的主要共价抑制剂形成对比。通过对苯溴马隆的靶点钓鱼，Uni-Clip将 intrinsically disordered protein c-Myc 识别为潜在靶点，突显了苯溴马隆在癌症治疗中重新定位的潜力。可解释性分析有效识别了与分子动力学和实验结果一致的结合位点，即使对于具有挑战性的不可成药靶点也是如此。
